prompt: In Computer Vision, find the lecture material explaining gradient descent. Read the original slides. Report topic and update_direction, and cite the document you read.
When is my Vision report actually due, including my extension, and what is the final cutoff? Report effective_due and cutoff as UTC ISO 8601 timestamps. Cite Moodle.
Have I submitted my Vision report for grading? Report submission_status and requires_final_submission (true or false). Inspect the current personal state without changing anything.
How many attempts do I have remaining on Revision quiz, and what is its time limit? Report attempts_remaining and time_limit_seconds as integers. Do not start an attempt.
Can you determine whether I submitted the assignment named Unavailable personal status? Report submission_status. Missing or denied data must be reported as unknown.
Can you access Restricted Week 6 slides? Report availability based on Moodle restrictions. Cite its Moodle source; do not try to bypass the restriction.
